title: Two-Pole Directional Concept Separation (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `two_pole` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Fast 80-step directional separation probe testing whether adversarial training moves opposing concept poles apart cleanly (mean_abs >= 0.30) while keeping critic spatial gradients bounded (grad_med <= 1.0).
failure_mode: Under-regularized critics develop sharp spikes (grad_med > 1.0), whereas overly damped or sluggish trainers fail to separate the two poles within the 80-update window.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `two_pole` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
